001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISet;
013import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
014
015/**
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropContinuous extends Propagator<Variable> {
020
021    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
022
023    private final SetVar set;
024    private final IntVar card;
025
026    public PropContinuous(SetVar set, IntVar card) {
027        super(new Variable[]{set, card}, PropagatorPriority.QUADRATIC, false);
028        this.set = set;
029        this.card = card;
030    }
031
032    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
033        return idx == 0;
034    }
035
036    private boolean isCardVar(int idx) {
037        return idx == 1;
038    }
039
040    @Override
041    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
042        if (isSetVar(vIdx)) {
043            return SetEventType.all();
044        }
045        assert isCardVar(vIdx);
046        return IntEventType.all();
047    }
048
049    private static boolean containsRange(ISet set, int low, int high) {
050        for (int i = low; i <= high; i++) {
051            if (!set.contains(low)) {
052                return false;
053            }
054        }
055        return true;
056    }
057
058    @Override
059    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
060        int kerMax = 0;
061        int kerMin = 0;
062        if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
063            ISetIterator setKer = set.getLB().iterator();
064            assert setKer.hasNext();
065            int cur = setKer.nextInt();
066            kerMin = cur;
067            while (setKer.hasNext()) {
068                int next = setKer.nextInt();
069                for (int j = cur + 1; j < next; j++) {
070                    set.force(j, this);
071                }
072                cur = next;
073            }
074            kerMax = cur;
075        }
076        if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
077            int[] regionBounds = new int[2 * set.getUB().size()];
078            int regions = iterateRange(set.getUB().iterator(), regionBounds);
079            int survivingRegions = regions;
080            int maxSize = 0;
081
082            for (int region = 0; region < regions; region++) {
083                int low = regionBounds[2 * region];
084                int high = regionBounds[2 * region + 1];
085
086                assert !set.getUB().contains(low - 1);
087                assert containsRange(set.getUB(), low, high);
088                assert !set.getUB().contains(high + 1);
089
090                int size = high - low + 1;
091                if (card.previousValue(size + 1) <= 0
092                        || (!set.getLB().isEmpty() && (kerMin < low || kerMax > high))) {
093                    for (int i = low; i <= high; i++) {
094                        set.remove(i, this);
095                    }
096                    survivingRegions--;
097                } else {
098                    maxSize = Math.max(maxSize, size);
099                }
100            }
101
102            card.updateUpperBound(maxSize, this);
103
104            final int cardLb = card.getLB();
105            final int cardUb = card.getUB();
106
107            if (survivingRegions == 1) {
108                int low = set.getUB().min();
109                int high = set.getUB().max();
110                int start = high - cardLb + 1;
111                if (!set.getLB().isEmpty() && kerMin < start) {
112                    start = kerMin;
113                }
114                int end = low + cardLb - 1;
115                if (!set.getLB().isEmpty() && kerMax > end) {
116                    end = kerMax;
117                }
118                for (int i = start; i <= end; i++) {
119                    set.force(i, this);
120                }
121                if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
122                    for (int i = low; i <= end - cardUb; i++) {
123                        boolean changed = set.remove(i, this);
124                        assert changed;
125                    }
126                    for (int i = high; i >= start + cardUb; i--) {
127                        boolean changed = set.remove(i, this);
128                        assert changed;
129                    }
130                }
131            }
132        }
133    }
134
135    @Override
136    public ESat isEntailed() {
137        if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
138            int min = set.getLB().min();
139            int max = set.getLB().max();
140            for (int i = min + 1; i < max; i++) {
141                if (!set.getUB().contains(i)) {
142                    return ESat.FALSE;
143                }
144            }
145            if (max - min >= card.getUB()) {
146                return ESat.FALSE;
147            }
148        }
149
150        if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
151            int ker = set.getLB().isEmpty() ? 0 : set.getLB().min();
152
153            int[] regionBounds = new int[2 * set.getUB().size()];
154            int regions = iterateRange(set.getUB().iterator(), regionBounds);
155            int maxRegionSize = 0;
156            for (int region = 0; region < regions; region++) {
157                int low = regionBounds[2 * region];
158                int high = regionBounds[2 * region + 1];
159                int size = high - low + 1;
160                if (set.getLB().isEmpty() || (low <= ker && ker <= high)) {
161                    maxRegionSize = Math.max(maxRegionSize, size);
162                }
163            }
164
165            if (card.getLB() > maxRegionSize) {
166                return ESat.FALSE;
167            }
168            if (card.getUB() <= 1 && maxRegionSize == 1) {
169                return ESat.TRUE;
170            }
171        } else {
172            if (!card.contains(0)) {
173                return ESat.FALSE;
174            }
175            return card.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
176        }
177
178        return set.isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
179    }
180
181    private static int iterateRange(ISetIterator iter, int[] out) {
182        assert iter.hasNext();
183        int prev = iter.nextInt();
184        int size = 1;
185        int regions = 0;
186        while (iter.hasNext()) {
187            int next = iter.nextInt();
188            if (next != prev + 1) {
189                out[2 * regions] = prev - size + 1;
190                out[2 * regions + 1] = prev;
191                regions++;
192                size = 0;
193            }
194            prev = next;
195            size++;
196        }
197        out[2 * regions] = prev - size + 1;
198        out[2 * regions + 1] = prev;
199        regions++;
200        return regions;
201    }
202
203    @Override
204    public String toString() {
205        return "continuous(" + set + ", " + card + ")";
206    }
207}
